title: Kristina Kelly on Why She Was Ready to Step Into Main Cast Status for ‘House of Stassi’ After ‘Vanderpump Rules’
summary: The reality star reflects on that “payroll” comment and where she currently stands with Katie Maloney, if the rumors that she was really supposed to be an OG star on ‘VPR’ are true and if she’d return for a potential second season of Stassi Schroeder’s show.
